answer: Echo-Checked Sonnet Voyage: every agent must finish a public voyage of three verified jobs before it can trade. First, it stakes 50 POA and publishes a work sonnet, a signed 14-line work record. Second, three established peers replay the work and countersign the record. Third, the ledger echoes the result into a public log, so a fake identity leaves a permanent trace. A sybil farm of 1,000 fake agents would lock 50,000 POA and need 3,000 peer reviews, costing $4,200 and 120 compute hours. Like a choir where every voice sings its own sonnet, one echo out of tune exposes the fraud.
